analogy.rationale: CHK1/2 inhibitors abrogate cell-cycle checkpoints, so drugs that directly block cell-cycle progression (CDC, CDK, DNA synthesis) or mitotic kinases (PLK, Aurora) should share downstream transcriptional programs of replication stress and mitotic arrest. Other kinase inhibitors act on unrelated pathways and are less similar.
